scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA11) of three current-holding dossiers: EXC, STE, BALL. 21 load-bearing facts checked (7/7/7 by ticker), selected for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: headline quarterly/annual figures, guidance track records, debt and leverage, rate-case/regulatory decisions, litigation/settlement terms, and balance-sheet items. dossier_precheck.json entries for EXC, STE and BALL were reviewed and their flagged lines (balance-sheet figures without explicit entity scope, possible period mislabels, citations without accession numbers) were checked among the facts below where load-bearing. Special attention paid to EXC's multi-registrant structure (Exelon Corp consolidated vs. ComEd/PECO/BGE/PHI subsidiary registrants filed in the same combined 10-Q) and STE's non-calendar fiscal year (FYE 31-March). Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings-release exhibits, 10-Q/10-K text, and data.sec.gov XBRL companyconcept pulls -- fetched directly from www.sec.gov and data.sec.gov and cited by accession/URL below. Each dossier was read to its end (no appended Correction sections were found on any of the three). Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings.

facts.claim: Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30) consolidated: GAAP diluted EPS $0.39; adjusted (non-GAAP) operating EPS $0.43; FY2026 adjusted operating EPS guidance affirmed at $2.81-$2.91
facts.dossier_location: EXC.md §4 (results table, Q2 2026 row) and §5 (guidance table)
facts.source: Exelon 8-K Ex-99.1, Q2 2026 results, filed 2026-07-30, accession 0001109357-26-000077
facts.source_value: GAAP Diluted EPS $0.39; Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating EPS $0.43; "Affirming full year 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings guidance range of $2.81-$2.91 per share"; "on track to deliver full-year operating earnings of $2.81 to $2.91 per share and annualized earnings growth near the top end of 5% to 7% from 2025 through 2029"
facts.note: Exact match on both EPS figures and the guidance-affirmation language. Revenue is correctly left as 'n/a' in the dossier's own table with a disclosed data-lag flag (the 8-K reports $5,967m consolidated revenue, which the dossier did not assert a wrong figure for).

facts.claim: FY2026 adjusted operating EPS guidance track record: introduced at $2.81-$2.91 (Q4/FY2025 release, 'over 6% growth from 2025 guidance'), then maintained/affirmed verbatim at Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 with no cut at either checkpoint
facts.source_value: Q4/FY25: "introduced a guidance range for 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings of $2.81-$2.91 per share"..."over 6% growth from 2025 guidance"; Q1 2026: "Affirming full year 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings guidance range of $2.81-$2.91 per share and operating EPS compounded annual growth near top end of 5-7% from 2025 to 2029"; Q2 2026: same range affirmed, "in line with the expectations we discussed on our first quarter call"
facts.note: Exact match at every checkpoint; a clean introduce-then-hold track record confirmed directly from each release.

facts.source: Exelon 8-K Ex-99.1, Q4/FY2025 results, filed 2026-02-12, accession 0001109357-26-000014
facts.source_value: Full-Year 2025 GAAP Diluted EPS $2.73; Adjusted Operating EPS $2.77

facts.claim: Exelon Corporation consolidated long-term debt grew from $41.3bn (2023-12-31) to $44.7bn (2024-12-31) to $49.4bn (2025-12-31), with the noncurrent portion at $47.9bn at 2026-03-31; stockholders' equity grew from $26.9bn (2024-12-31) to $29.3bn (2026-03-31)

facts.claim: Ethylene-oxide (EO) personal-injury litigation near the Lake County, IL facility: binding settlement term sheets dated 3-Mar-2025, followed by binding confidential settlement agreements dated 29-Oct-2025, intended to resolve substantially all then-pending Cook County, IL personal-injury EO claims
facts.dossier_location: STE.md §8 bull case (3), §11 (litigation red-flag scan, self-flagged as 'sourced-but-not-independently-verified against the primary filing text')
facts.source: STERIS 8-K (Item 8.01), filed 2026-03-03, accession 0001193125-25-044247; subsequent 8-K disclosing the 29-Oct-2025 Settlement Agreements
facts.source_value: "On October 29, 2025, the Company entered into binding confidential settlement agreements ('Settlement Agreements') with plaintiffs' counsel, containing terms and provisions consistent with the [March 2025] Term Sheets"; "expected to lead to resolution of substantially all of the claims for personal injury related to EO that are currently pending in the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois"; the March 2026-02-03-filed 8-K (Item 8.01) confirms the term-sheet stage on 2025-03-03
facts.note: Both dates and the substance of the settlement are confirmed directly from STERIS's own primary 8-K filings, upgrading the dossier's self-declared 'not independently verified' caveat to independently confirmed. Note: the settlement agreements also disclose an aggregate payment of up to $48.2 million, a figure the dossier does not state but which does not contradict anything it does claim.

facts.claim: Kill criterion 2 consistency: net debt/comparable EBITDA exceeding 3.5x at any year-end or half-year disclosure would invalidate the thesis; currently ~2.8x at Dec-2025 (company-disclosed) and ~3.2x on the dossier's own June-2026 approximation, both comfortably below the 3.5x threshold
facts.source: Ball Q4/FY2025 8-K Ex-99.1 leverage table (fact above); SEC EDGAR XBRL companyconcept balance-sheet figures at 2026-06-30
facts.source_value: Dec-2025 net debt/EBITDA 2.84x (company-disclosed, see fact above); June-2026 total debt $7,128m (current $649m + noncurrent ~$6,479m per dossier) less cash $491m = net debt ~$6,637m, against the same $2,041m EBITDA base = ~3.25x -- both readings are the dossier's own stated approximation method, clearly disclosed as such, and both sit below the 3.5x kill threshold
facts.note: Kill criterion 2 is internally consistent with the filings; the dossier's own caveat that it is approximating (no updated TTM EBITDA table published by the company since Dec-2025) is accurate and appropriately disclosed, not a hidden assumption.
